topics.topic: Meal Planning for Vulnerable Family Groups: Toddlers, pregnant women, and convalescents
learningObjectives: Outline nutritional imperatives for physiological stages of human lifecycle
Formulate balanced daily meal regimens for toddlers and expectant mothers
Adapt convalescent diets for digestibility, fluid replenishment, and healing

topics.topic: Table Setting, Dining Etiquette, and Buffet Service
learningObjectives: Demonstrate formal and informal covers for three-course Nigerian meals
Practice table etiquette regarding cutlery usage, posture, and conversation
Organize buffet layouts ensuring hygienic food temperature regulation

topics.topic: Consumer Rights and Redress in Domestic Markets
learningObjectives: Explain universal rights of consumers (safety, information, choice, redress)
Identify roles of FCCPC, SON, and NAFDAC in checking adulteration
Draft formal complaints seeking restitution for defective commercial goods

topics.topic: Pattern Drafting and Garment Construction Tools
learningObjectives: Take accurate anatomical measurements for bodice and skirt drafting
Use tracing wheels, tailors chalk, tape rules, and French curves
Draft basic paper pattern blocks with seam allowances and grain line markings

topics.topic: Garment Construction: Sleeves, collars, and edge finishes
learningObjectives: Draft set-in sleeves and flat Peter Pan collars from basic blocks
Attach sleeves ensuring correct easing around armhole contours
Apply bias bindings and facings as clean decorative edge finishes

topics.topic: Fasteners and Openings: Zips, buttons, hooks-and-eyes, and plackets
learningObjectives: Construct continuous wrap and bound placket openings
Sew buttons, hooks, and press studs securely with thread shanks
Insert concealed and semi-concealed zippers into skirt waistbands

topics.topic: Mid-Term Continuous Assessment & Mock Garment Drafting
learningObjectives: Examine student mastery of consumer rights and meal planning principles
Assess accuracy of paper patterns drafted to standard school child dimensions
Offer remedial intervention on pattern adjustments and seam allowances

topics.topic: Textile Science: Natural and synthetic fibers (cotton, silk, polyester)

Perform burning tests and microscopic observation on fiber samples
Relate fiber properties to laundering temperatures and iron settings

topics.topic: Care Labeling, Fabric Finishes, and Wardrobe Planning
learningObjectives: Interpret international laundry and textile care symbols on clothing
Explain permanent and renewable fabric finishes (mercerization, flame proofing)
Plan personal wardrobes on moderate budgets utilizing capsule wardrobe concepts

topics.topic: Household Budgeting, Family Resource Management, and Savings
learningObjectives: Identify human and non-human family resources available for goal attainment
Draft a monthly family expenditure budget prioritizing statutory overheads
Evaluate banking savings schemes and cooperative thrift societies in Nigeria

topics.topic: Child Care and Immunization: Milestones and infant health
learningObjectives: Track developmental milestones from infancy through early childhood
Detail National Programme on Immunization (NPI) schedule in Nigeria
Manage common childhood ailments (colic, teething fever, diaper dermatitis)

topics.topic: Comprehensive Revision on Home Economics & BECE Practical Clinic
learningObjectives: Synthesize concepts in food nutrition, textile science, and child welfare
Simulate full BECE practical garment construction and cookery tasks
Grade completed projects against WAEC/NECO junior benchmark rubrics

topics.topic: Terminal Examination and BECE Garment Portfolio Assessment
learningObjectives: Evaluate cumulative Junior Secondary Home Economics competencies
Score final sewn garments and baked food submissions
Certify broadsheet marks for Junior Secondary Certificate Examination
